summary: Frontend-only retest on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 for showroom /customizer. All four fixes from iteration_1 verified: (1) NK201/NK202/NK203 chain is now visibly continuous around the neck in front view (single gold oval meeting the pendant at the collarbone) - no invisible mid-chain sections; (2) mobile 390x844 ring view now frames the full hand - wrist AND forearm end AND all five fingers are inside the canvas, no left-edge clip; (3) data-testid=panel-collapse DOES exist on the expanded WornItemsPanel on both desktop and mobile (previous iteration_1 selector claim corrected - it was a false positive because panel starts collapsed and only exposes panel-toggle; after clicking panel-toggle, panel-collapse count == 1 and works to collapse); (4) showroom header sits at top=0 with NO announcement bar on /customizer, no root document scroll (scrollHeight == clientHeight on both viewports), while /shop still keeps its announcement bar (regression intact). Anchor-persist across view switches also still works.

issues: Front view now reads as a continuous gold oval chain and is a clear improvement over iteration_1's floating arcs. When orbiting ~30deg, the far half of the chain correctly hides behind the bust, but the near-side chain arc still visually plants into the shoulder curve (small intersection where the chain meets the bust silhouette). Non-blocking; only visible on slight orbit, not on front view.

verified_flows: Desktop NK201/NK202/NK203 front view: continuous gold chain oval around neck ending at pendant - no burial.
Desktop and mobile: panel-toggle exists when panel collapsed; clicking it exposes panel-collapse (count=1); clicking panel-collapse re-collapses to panel-toggle. Round-trip works on both viewports.
Mobile 390x844 ring view: full forearm + hand + 5 fingers contained in canvas, no wrist clip.
Mobile 390x844 wrist view: forearm and hand fully framed.
Showroom /customizer: header top=0, no announcement bar element, no root scrollbar (clientHeight==scrollHeight) on both 1920x1080 and 390x844.
Regression /shop: announcement bar element still present.
Reset View button clickable on desktop; orbit drag applies rotation without teardown.
screenshot_evidence_note: Screenshots were captured through mcp_browser_automation and are returned inline as output_image artifacts in the tool run (5 desktop necklace shots including NK201 front, NK202 front+orbit, NK203 front+orbit; 3 mobile shots for RG101 ring view, wrist view, and camera-view-wrist switch). They live in the automation container filesystem and are NOT copied to /app/test_reports/screenshots (which is why iteration_1's listed .png paths didn't actually exist on the shared FS). Main agent should reference the inline artifacts from this iteration's tool run.
action_items: Task doc references data-testid=view-wrist / view-ring / view-neck for camera switching, but the actual DOM uses camera-view-wrist / camera-view-ring / camera-view-neck. Either rename the testids or update the task contract - minor selector-contract mismatch.

Optional polish: near-side necklace chain arc slightly intersects the shoulder curve on ~30deg orbit; consider a tiny outward radial offset so the chain reads as sitting on top of the bust from every angle.
critical_code_review_comments: Mannequin.tsx still uses non-null assertions on getObjectByName('HandDisplay') / ('NeckDisplay'). If bustSection regeneration ever renames those nodes, the render loop will crash with a TypeError instead of falling back gracefully. Suggest optional-chaining + a one-time console.warn.

Showroom removes AnnouncementBar and shifts header top to 0 via a `showroom` prop on Header + StorefrontLayout. Header height (72px desktop / 64px mobile) is now the only chrome above the canvas - any future change to Header height silently changes h-[calc(100dvh-Xrem)] math in JewelryCustomizer. Consider extracting the header-height into a CSS var so the customizer picks it up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Camera-view switch buttons use data-testid=camera-view-{wrist,ring,neck} (NOT view-wrist). panel-toggle appears only when panel is collapsed; panel-collapse only when expanded - never both simultaneously. Zustand key shynish-3d-tryon, cart key eshara-cart. Screenshots from mcp_browser_automation are container-local, do NOT record them as shared file paths in future reports; reference inline output_image artifacts instead. To force the panel-toggle path, call localStorage.removeItem('shynish-3d-tryon') before navigation.
